---
id: env.cover.claims-made-and-notified
type: cover
heading: Claims Made and Notified
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

This policy covers only claims first made against you, and pollution conditions first discovered by you, during the policy period, and notified to us in writing during the policy period or within the extended reporting period under [[ref:env.cover.extended-reporting-period]].

If, during the policy period, you become aware of facts that might give rise to a claim and you notify us of them in writing as soon as reasonably practicable and before the policy period ends, a claim later made arising from those facts is treated as made during the policy period. This has the effect provided in s.40(3) of the Insurance Contracts Act 1984 (Cth).

All claims and all clean-up costs arising from the same pollution condition, or from related pollution conditions, are treated as one claim first made when the first of them was made or the pollution condition was first discovered, as [[ref:env.pay.related-pollution-conditions]] sets out.
